A '''sturdy leather gambeson''' is the [[Sturdy leather armor|sturdy leather]] [[Armor#Chestplate|chestplate]], crafted from 8 [[sturdy leather]]. Sturdy leather armor is a light set built against arrows and falls.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}
The gambeson found in [[village]] tannery chests is an older version of the item. In 1.12.2 it is invisible when worn: its equipment asset is <code>minecraft:sturdy_leather</code>, but the resource pack defines the texture as <code>matcha:sturdy_leather</code>. It also gives 4 armor instead of 5 and 1 block of safe fall distance instead of 2, has one extra random enchantment, and is repaired with sturdy leather instead of tattered leather.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/equipment/sturdy_leather.json}}</ref> See [[Sturdy leather armor#Village tannery chests]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
It gives 5 armor with 350 durability and 2 blocks of safe fall distance, twice what leather gives. Projectile Protection IV comes on the item as an ordinary enchantment.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[tattered leather]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
